description.correction: OCR.space extracts text from images and PDFs, supports multiple OCR languages and formats, and offers optional table recognition and searchable-PDF creation. Current documentation does not list a search/replace feature.

notes: Official 2026 documentation identifies API version 5.22.1 and supports the endpoint, API-key authentication, 500 requests/day per IP, and 25,000 monthly Engine 1/2 conversions. Engine 3 has a separate 2,500-conversion free quota. The description appears to confuse searchable-PDF creation with nonexistent search/replace functionality. No explicit official CORS policy was found.
